criteria.criterion: streamed the whole part and stopped on request (no error, stall or end of stream)
released at the stop within 5 s (stop reads, Flush, reader release, source shutdown; all bounded)
valid JPEG (SOI, EOI, SOF size) >= 99% of frames, kept samples decode strictly
frames lost in the MF sample-time slots <= max(1, 0.1% of frames)
arrival gaps > 1.5 nominal periods <= max(1, 0.1% of frames) (not rated where the 16 ms host grid makes such intervals normal, i.e. 60 fps)
delivered fps >= 98% of nominal (an even lower rate with no lost slot = the camera's rate, not rated; W-MJPEG rates it)
